messages:
Ally (People Ops): Quick update on SOC2/ISO evidence  were extending the team attestation & evidence upload deadline to Apr 20 to account for end-of-quarter travel. Please read below and action by Apr 20.
Ally (People Ops): What we need from every manager: 1) Signed manager attestation PDF (fillable) 2) Team completion CSV for mandatory trainings (privacy + secure-coding) 3) Any exception requests (contractors, vendors) with justification. Upload to the protected Confluence folder only. Link: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/COMPLIANCE/pages/Team+Evidence
Priya (Compliance): Note: ISO auditors will want the signed attestations and the CSVs with header columns exactly as below. If the CSV header mismatches we have to re-request, which delays the audit.
Priya (Compliance): Required CSV header (exact): 
```employee_email,display_name,role,training_name,training_completed_at,cert_url```
Jordan (Security): A few clarifications: - training_completed_at must be ISO8601 (UTC) - cert_url should be an internal Okta or LMS link (not a personal Dropbox) - for contractors, include company/vendor column and a flag "is_contractor" set to true
Marco (Sales Ops): If we have folks in EMEA with GDPR questions, who do they contact? We had a rep ask about data retention in training.
Ally (People Ops): For GDPR/training content questions ping Priya or Nina. Weve added a short FAQ on the Confluence page for EMEA nuances.
Nina (People Ops Intern): Small reminder: if your cert doesn't auto-post to Okta, save the PDF and upload it to the Confluence "uploads/evidence" via the page. Filename format: teamname_lastname_firstname_cert.pdf
Marco (Sales Ops): Will the attestation require digital signature or is a scanned signed PDF OK?
Priya (Compliance): Digitally signed preferred but a scanned signature is acceptable if the PDF shows the printed name and date. Were collecting these for the annual attestation package.
Jordan (Security): Also, security evidence: for teams that store customer data you must include a short note (one line) in the attestation form listing data stores (e.g., S3 buckets, Postgres clusters). That helps map shadow assets for the auditor.
Ally (People Ops): If a manager needs an earlier export of training completions (CSV) we can run one on Apr 14. Reply with team slug by Apr 10 and well schedule it.
Marco (Sales Ops): Adding my team (enterprise-sales). Thanks.
contractor-bot: Reminder: Contractors must be listed in vendor CSV by Apr 20 per People Ops request.
Nina (People Ops Intern): Exception requests: DM me + cc your manager and Priya. Approvals take ~48 hours.
Ally (People Ops): Final note  please avoid uploading evidence to public channels or shared drives. Use the protected Confluence folder or the S3 uploader linked on the page. If you run into permission errors, DM me and include a screenshot.
Priya (Compliance): Thanks everyone. We appreciate managers helping us close the loop for this audit window.
Ally (People Ops): Will post a short checklist + a sample filled CSV on the Confluence page in ~1 hour. Ill also send a calendar reminder to managers for Apr 16.
